question: An angle greater than 180 degrees is called a ________________.
solution: The correct answer is __Reflex angle****.__ **__Key Points__** __ • An angle greater than 180 degrees__ is called a reflex angle. • A reflex angle is always greater than 180° but less than 360°. • In geometry, it is measured in an anti-clockwise direction from the initial side to the terminal side. • Examples of reflex angles include 200°, 270°, and 310°. • Reflex angles appear commonly in rotational movements and circular measurements. **__Additional Information__** • **Acute Angle:** • An angle that measures less than 90°. • Examples include 30°, 45°, and 60°. • **Right Angle:** • A right angle is exactly 90°. • It is formed by two perpendicular lines. • **Obtuse Angle:** • An angle that measures greater than 90° but less than 180°. • Examples include 120°, 135°, and 150°. 61:Tda0,
